Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fighting game whole-body raster sprites on a truly transparent background. A perfectly spaced 4 column x 4 row grid, exactly 16 isolated complete whole-body poses, no labels, no text, no cell lines, no ground shadows, NO attack effects, NO glow or dust. Every pose fits fully INSIDE its own cell with at least 25 pixels clear on ALL sides. No head, weapon, scarf, hair, foot may cross a cell boundary. Keep the same adult/child proportions, head size, limb lengths, face, clothes, equipment and polished detailed anime cel shading throughout. Baseline body height per figure about 170-185 pixels in a 1536x1024 sheet. All active poses look and move toward image RIGHT, three-quarter side view; turn is the only opposite angle. Row-major order: 0 neutral ready stance facing an opponent on the right (NOT a front-facing character sheet pose); 1 left foot forward walking; 2 walking passing; 3 right foot forward walking; 4 walking passing opposite; 5 run long stride; 6 run tucked passing; 7 opposite run stride; 8 opposite tucked passing; 9 dash launch low; 10 braking step; 11 crouch; 12 turning; 13 jump squat; 14 jump ascent; 15 second jump. Important: cell0 proportions are the fixed identity baseline for all future sprites. Reference is for design and pose intent, do not copy its labels/effects or other characters.
Character: Arthur from Ghosts 'n Goblins exactly as attached. Short stocky muscular bearded middle-aged knight, ginger-brown beard, bushy eyebrows and comically determined face, silver steel open-faced helmet, SILVER full plate armor (standard armor only), brown leather accents, steel gauntlets and boots, armed with a short silver lance/spear. Do not draw golden armor or underwear form in this sheet. Preserve compact broad sturdy body, short limbs and large expressive face.

Face, collar and shoulder upper body ONLY, not full body or distant waist-up. Crisp professional anime game illustration matching the supplied character design. Precise eyes, high detail linework and cel shaded highlights. Three-quarter view towards the RIGHT, confident fighting expression. No text, logos, frame, UI, symbols or background. This is a separately illustrated high resolution portrait, never an enlarged sprite.
Arthur from Ghosts 'n Goblins: middle-aged broad ginger-brown bearded knight with huge determined expressive eyes and eyebrows, silver open faced helmet, silver round steel shoulder plates. Standard silver armor, not gold, strong heroic humorous charm.
